name: Hotel Alpin
beschreibung: The traditional Hotel Alpin welcomes holidaymakers to the picturesque village centre of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser at Dorf 31, nestled directly at the foot of the dramatic Kaisergebirge mountain scenery. Tastefully styled in alpine timber woodwork, the guest rooms feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting stunning vistas of the rugged Wilder Kaiser cliffs. To unwind after rewarding mountain hikes or days on the snow, guests can relax in the cosy on-site sauna area with Finnish sauna, steam room, and peaceful loungers. Half-board dining includes a nutritious breakfast buffet packed with regional specialities and hearty Tyrolean dinners in the evening. The ski bus stops right outside the front door, whisking skiers to the Brandstadlbahn gondola into the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental within minutes. Summer invites swimming at Lake Hintersteiner See and exploring KaiserWelt.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy traditional hotel at Dorf 31 in Scheffau at the Wilder Kaiser featuring sunny balconies, sauna facilities, and half-board dining.
